title: Remove Element
statement_short: Given an integer array and a target value, remove all occurrences of that target value in-place. Return the number of elements remaining after placing valid elements in the front of the array.
hint: Small array size places no time restriction, but elements must be overwritten in-place with O(1) space.
why_not: Right: Two Pointers (read and write indices) overwrite target values in a single O(n) pass in-place. Not Sliding Window: The task requires modifying array elements across the entire array, not identifying an optimal continuous window. Not HashMap / Hash Set: Using a hash set requires O(n) auxiliary space, violating the in-place constraint. Not Stack: Pushing valid elements to a stack consumes O(n) extra memory.
